title: Consolidate output
description: What the model returns for a consolidate generation: the recap of a cell or a beat at three levels of detail, which later contexts show in place of it.

condensed.description: About half the length of the part: every event, who acts, what matters of what they say, and what changes, in narrative order.

compact.description: About a tenth of the part: the events that matter to the rest of the story, and what changes.

essentials.description: One sentence that says what the part does for the story.

names.description: Every character, place and object the part names, each once, as the part writes it.
